description: Add a room or a unit of equipment to a project's resources, or change the one named by 'id' — the WHOLE of it as written. Without 'id', an 'externalId' the project has changes that resource. Its buffers are minutes before and after an event during which it is still busy (setting up, clearing). Setting 'status' to 'repair' keeps it on the events that have it — they then show a conflict — and refuses it to new ones. Conflicts that appear or clear are told to webhooks of 'calendar:resource_conflict'. Anybody who may write in the project.

bufferAfter.description: Minutes after an event it is busy (clearing), 0-1440.

bufferBefore.description: Minutes before an event it is busy (setting up), 0-1440.

externalId.description: Your own id for it, unique in the project.

id.description: The resource to change. Leave out to add one.

moveMinutes.description: Minutes it takes to move or hang it at another point, 0-1440 — what a reconfiguration moving it lasts. Leave out to keep (15 for a new one).

x.description: Where it stands on the plan, millimetres.

y.description: Where it stands on the plan, millimetres.

name: set_resource
title: Set resource
